faq.kl1ats: Everything starts with a free consultation. Contact us, tell us about your idea, and we will offer the best solution.
faq.kl2: What types of websites do you create?
faq.kl2ats: We create all types of websites – from business sites to e-commerce stores, blogs, landing pages and specialized web platforms.
faq.kl3: How long does it take to build a website?
faq.kl3ats: Depending on complexity, website creation takes 1 to 4 weeks. A simple single-page website can be done in 1-2 weeks.
faq.kl4: How much does a website cost?
faq.kl4ats: Prices start from €299 for a single-page website. We provide a customized quote for each project based on your needs.
faq.kl5: Can you update my old website?
faq.kl5ats: Yes, we often redesign old websites. We give them a modern look, better performance and new features.
faq.kl6ats: Hosting is not included in the price, but we recommend reliable hosting providers and can help you choose.
faq.kl7: Do you create unique designs or use templates?
faq.kl7ats: We offer both options. We can create a unique design from scratch or use templates – it depends on your budget and needs.
